translations.web: You who tear yourself in your anger, will the earth be forsaken for you? Or will the rock be removed out of its place?
translations.bsb: You who tear yourself in anger— should the earth be forsaken on your account, or the rocks be moved from their place?
translations.kjv: He teareth himself in his anger: shall the earth be forsaken for thee? and shall the rock be removed out of his place?
translations.asv: Thou that tearest thyself in thine anger, Shall the earth be forsaken for thee? Or shall the rock be removed out of its place?
